title: Lover's Ledger
tagline: Relationship and encounter statistics ledger for SkyrimNet character bios.
description:
## What this mod does?

Tracks OStim interactions between npcs and record all ositm related information: npcs encounters, lovers, positions, etc... Caluclates based on data scores for lovers.

## How does it integrates with SkyrimNet?

It adds a few context pieces to tell SkyrimNet npc's sexual history, their lovers and npc's preferences like if they prefer couple encounters, group encounters, sexual preferences, etc...
author: tetherball88
